$comment: Onboarding screen 4: openness to kinds of work. PDR 5.2 stores openness_to_modalities as modality slugs, and PDR 7.2 filters with `m.slug = any($openness)`. Twenty-one checkboxes is a terrible screen, so the UI offers five family-level choices and the store expands each to its member slugs before persisting. The stored contract stays exactly as the PDR specifies; only the screen is kinder. `expands_to` is asserted against modalities.json in the schema test, so adding a modality without placing it here fails a test rather than silently dropping it from every user's pool.
